npx_version: 11.9.0
git_sha: a431978cd2622b0cc3613bfb7248e11d996b7b92
notes: Real local capture of `npx --yes tsc --noEmit` produced only the bare TS
       error line (npx printed no preamble because tsc was already locally
       installed). To exercise the strip_patterns (npm warn / npm notice / npm
       install / npm WARN), this fixture is synthetic: the noise lines are
       transcribed from documented npx 11.x output formats and the trailing
       TS2322 + "Found 1 error" lines come from the real tsc 5.6.3 capture.
